examples.english: What is that large building used for?

notes:
{建物|たてもの} is the general term for any building or structure.

WORD FORMATION:
{建|た}てる (to build) + {物|もの} (thing)

TYPES OF BUILDINGS:
- ビル: office building, high-rise
- {家|いえ}/{住宅|じゅうたく}: house, residence
- アパート/マンション: apartment building
- {倉庫|そうこ}: warehouse

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {建物|たてもの}を{建|た}てる: to construct a building
- {古|ふる}い{建物|たてもの}: old building
- {建物|たてもの}の{中|なか}: inside the building
